title: Pure bending through a distributing coupling
source: Euler–Bernoulli pure bending, σ = M_y z/I, θ = ML/(EI) (exact in elasticity for ν = 0); Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., 1970, §102

quantities.quantity: bending stress σ_xx at mid-span, top fibre (10, 0.5, 1)
quantities.reason: with ν = 0 pure bending is a quadratic displacement field that hex20 represents exactly; the coupling's nodal force pattern differs from the linear traction only within a depth or two of the end (Saint-Venant), five depths from the probe

quantities.quantity: rotation of the reference point about y
quantities.reason: the reference point follows the best-fit rigid motion of the end section, which the end zone's local deformation disturbs by well under 1%
quantities.known_failure: 1.2% high: the distributing coupling weights every node of the end face equally, corner and mid-side nodes of hex20 alike, which is not the consistent linear traction; the end face deforms locally and the fitted rotation includes it. Area-consistent weights would remove it
